normalization.name: also remove npm scope, leading DSH/DeepSeek Harness and trailing plugin, punctuation
normalization.description: normalized variant removes punctuation, separators and symbols; exact variant only NFKC/lower/trim

limitations: A repeated repository/name/description is a review lead, not proof of duplicate functionality or copying.
Owner means declared GitHub repository namespace, not a verified human author.
A repository may contain several distinct plugins; a version string is not a distinct plugin.
Source descriptions and capability flags are catalog claims, not execution verification.
